prompt: In many societies, a growing number of older people live alone and have little regular contact with others. What are the causes of this isolation, and what could be done to reduce it?
essay:
In the modern society, a lot of old people are living alone and they are feeling very lonely because they do not have the contact with the other people. This is a growing problem in many countries and in this essay I will discuss the causes and also I will suggest some solutions for this problem.

The first cause of this problem is the change of the family structure. In the past, the grandparents, the parents and the children were living together in one house, but nowadays the young people are moving to the big cities for the work or for the study, so the old parents are staying alone in their home town. Secondly, the modern life is very busy. The young people are working long hours and they do not have the time to visit their parents regularly. Moreover, when the old people are retiring, they are losing the contact with their colleagues, and if their health is not good they can not go outside easily.

However, there are some solutions. Firstly, the family should give more time to their old parents and they should visit them at least one time in a week. Secondly, the government should build more community centres where the old people can meet each other and do some activities together. In addition, we should teach the old people how to use the technology, for example the video call, so they can talk with their family every day.

In conclusion, the causes of this problem are the change of the family, the busy life and the retirement, and the solutions are the family visits, the community centres and the technology. The society must not forget the old people who gave us so much.
title: Loneliness among older people
